kurzbeschreibung: The Bergbaumuseum Bad Häring documents the fascinating era of Tyrolean coal mining and the discovery of the curative sulfur spring.
beschreibung:
Mining Tradition in the Unterinntal

The Bergbaumuseum Bad Häring in the spa resort at the foot of the Pölven commemorates an era of coal extraction lasting more than two centuries. From the 18th century to the mid-20th century, lignite coal mining decisively shaped the daily life of the village community.

From Miners' Village to Renowned Health Resort

The exhibition showcases historic mine charts, drilling tools, pit lamps, and mineral specimens. A special chapter is dedicated to the discovery of a potent sulfur spring in 1951 inside a mining tunnel, which heralded the transition of Bad Häring into Tyrol's first officially accredited spa resort.
